dataset: RGE ALTI ground elevation resource ign_rge_alti_wld
source_frame: Final retained Monaco source east/north with explicit effective geoscale; no image fit.
interpolation: 2m sampled lattice of service ground values, bilinear between samples; nominal sample interval is not a measured accuracy claim.
limitations: Provider reports variable source accuracy. Narrow street/retaining/underground levels are not automatically resolved by a terrain model; exact lower street-front architecture is separately reconstructed.
scope: Only actual hotel507048725/retail508221117 footprints and narrow lower quay-facing strip; all protected roads including upper BeauRivage arm excluded.
